newsitem.title: UK: UK new car registrations up 2.4 pct in Feb - SMMT.
newsitem.headline: UK new car registrations up 2.4 pct in Feb - SMMT.

text.p: British new car registrations rose by 2.4 percent to 162,887 in February, from 159,013 a year ago, to give a total for the year to date of 369,671, up from 350,774 for the same year-ago period, car industry group SMMT Ltd said on Thursday.

"Although the overall car market shows a modest increase it is disappointing to see no growth in retail sales," SMMT chief executive Ernie Thompson said, commenting on a year-on-year fall in the volume of private car sales within the total.
Cars from the Ford Motor Co stable continued to dominate the top of the sales list, with the medium-sized Mondeo February's top seller with 8,797 vehicles sold.

The compact Vauxhall Astra, made by the local unit of another U.S. giant General Motors Corp, broke into the ranks of Ford's traditionally-dominant top three sellers in the month by taking second place with 7,909 registrations.
However, in the two months of the year measured so far Ford's Mondeo, Escort and Fiesta have the top three slots with combined cumulative registrations of over 59,200.
Private registrations took 42 percent of the market in the month, compared with 43 percent last year, the SMMT added.
